chunks: It is God who created seven heavens and from the earth [created] as many of them; the command descends between them so that you may know that God is over all things omnipotent and that God has encompassed all things in knowledge.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's creation of the heavens and earths and His knowledge?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'seven earths' (Arḍ) are often interpreted not merely as physical layers but as distinct spiritual or metaphysical realms, mirroring the celestial hierarchy to illustrate the comprehensive scope of divine decree. This verse reinforces the concept of God's omnipotence and omniscience as the foundation for the legal rulings on divorce, reminding believers that divine legislation is rooted in absolute knowledge and power. The descent of 'command' (Amr) signifies the continuous flow of divine will through the ranks of creation, including the Imams who serve as the earthly manifestation of this authority.
